segments.title: Opening Remarks
segments.introScript: Please welcome to the stage the President of HUNSA, who will open this wonderful evening.

segments.title: Traditional Dance
segments.introScript: Up next, a beautiful traditional folk dance celebrating the rich heritage of Nepal. Please welcome the Nepal Folk Dance Group to the stage!
segments.notes: 5 performers. Need space on left side of stage.

segments.title: Modern Fusion
segments.introScript: Please welcome the Rhythm Collective with their electrifying modern fusion performance!
segments.notes: Audio starts automatically. Check sound levels before.

segments.title: Intermission
segments.introScript: We will now take a short 15-minute break. Please enjoy the refreshments available in the foyer. We will resume shortly.
segments.notes: Crew: reset stage during break. Check mic batteries.

segments.title: Guest Speaker
segments.introScript: We are truly honoured to welcome our distinguished guest speaker, Dr. Anil Sharma, to the stage.
segments.notes: Mic check beforehand. Water on podium.

segments.title: Choir Performance
segments.introScript: The HUNSA Choir will now perform a moving medley of Nepali songs that will touch your hearts.

segments.title: Drama Skit
segments.introScript: Please welcome the HUNSA Theatre Club for their original drama performance.
segments.notes: Props on stage right. Lighting cue at start.

segments.title: Closing Ceremony
segments.introScript: As we come to the end of this wonderful evening, please join us for the closing ceremony and award presentations.
